firm_data.firm_description: FisherBroyles was the first and is among the largest distributed law firms in the world. Our distributed model was built to eliminate the inefficiencies and overhead that burden traditional firms.
notable_facts: First distributed law firm to be ranked by The American Lawyer as one of the 200 largest law firms by revenue
technology_signals: Law Firm 2.0® model prioritizes efficiency and value
Distributed model leverages advanced technologies alongside experienced legal judgment

ai_contact.ai_notes: The firm redesigns legal workflows to leverage advanced technologies alongside experienced legal judgment.

email.subject: AI for FisherBroyles, built for your Law Firm 2.0® model
email.body:
Hi Judy,

Your Law Firm 2.0® model has always prioritized efficiency and value by redesigning legal workflows around advanced technologies. We built Lucio specifically for firms operating at that intersection.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms managing BigLaw demands with distributed teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on what matters: precision, client trust, and real operational efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in Atlanta to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping distributed practices compete with traditional BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
